title: BubbleSpawners
description: Turn spawner breaking into shard progression — with strong compatibility for stacking/mine-spawner plugins.
body:
A lightweight 🪶 spawner-shards plugin for **Paper 1.21+** ⚙️
Spawners drop **shards** 💎 instead of full spawners, with built-in 🛡️ anti-exploit logic and compatibility with common spawner/stacking plugins.

## ⚠️ Notice: Folia Support was not test
## 
### ✨ Features:
- 🧱 Break spawners → get a configurable amount of **spawner shards**
- 🍀 Optional **Fortune** bonus for shard amount
- ✂️ Optional **Silk Touch requirement**
- 🔐 Permissions + creative-mode safeguards
- 🧬 Typed spawner support (crafting output can preserve mob type)
- 🎵 QoL: actionbar + sound feedback on shard drops
- 🛡️ Anti-exploit & 🌍 world reset safety
- 🚫 Suppresses full spawner drops from other plugins when shards are awarded
- 🧨 Fixes the /rw resource-world reset exploit (ResourceWorlds / BubbleReset)
where spawners could start dropping full spawners after a reset/unload
- 🧾 Tracks player-placed spawners so you can restrict shard drops to **natural spawners only**
- 🔌 Integrations / Softdepends
- ⚡ Works standalone. Optional compatibility with:
  - 🌹 RoseStacker
  - 🧱 WildStacker
  - 🕸️ SilkSpawners / SilkSpawnersV2

### 🧾 Commands & Permissions
`/bubblespawners` (alias: /bubblespawner)

### 🔑 Permissions:
`bubblespawners.admin` (default: op)
`bubblespawners.toggle` (default: true)
`bubblespawners.receive` (default: true)

### 📝 Notes
🛠️ Built for Paper 1.21+ (api-version: 1.21)
🧪 Includes automated tests for reset/unload behavior and drop suppression
Folia Support has not been Tested (Yet)
